own_solution.law: t = ln(A1/A2)/(lam1 - lam2) with lam = ln2/T

defect_reasons.insufficient_boundary_condition: The certified wiring for T45EB assumes the extra 170 Bq batch is 'added at the moment of preparation', but the sentence ('Another 170 Bq batch of the longer-lived isotope is added to the sample') states neither when it is added nor at what moment it has 170 Bq, and a later addition gives a different crossing time.

counterexamples: T45EB with the batch added at t = 10 h and having 170 Bq then: equivalent preparation-time activity 170*2^(10/72) = 186.9 Bq, crossing at 72/11*log2(2400/686.9) = 11.82 h, not the certified 12.05 h.
